business_problem: TPFx needed a next-generation mobile trading platform that could handle up to 150,000 connections per minute while preserving security, zero-downtime availability, and fast multi-zone access for regulated financial transactions.
solution_summary: TPFx implemented a layered Alibaba Cloud architecture to launch a higher-scale mobile trading experience for Indonesian traders. Traffic enters through Application Load Balancer, while Auto Scaling expands capacity during peak trading windows and the application layer runs on Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK). A multi-layer security perimeter built from Anti-DDoS, Web Application Firewall, and Security Center protects the trading stack and supports regulatory expectations for sensitive transactions. State and high-speed access are supported by Tair for hot data and caching, while Object Storage Service and Simple Log Service provide durable storage and operational visibility for the trading environment. The deployment is anchored in Alibaba Cloud's Jakarta presence, giving TPFx local coverage for low-latency access while still supporting multi-zone resilience. Together the components let TPFx sustain rapid connection growth without sacrificing response time, security, or service continuity.
business_outcome: TPFx raised the ceiling for concurrent trading traffic while delivering faster, secure, always-on mobile trading experiences for Southeast Asian users.
architecture_clues: Designed for zero downtime during high trading volume
Anchored in Alibaba Cloud's Jakarta Region
Uses multi-layer security controls across network and application layers
Built for multi-zone access and fault tolerance
evidence_quotes: "TPFx needed to launch a next-generation mobile app capable of handling up to 150,000 connections per minute without compromising speed, security, or availability."
"Alibaba Cloud’s Anti-DDoS, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Security Center established a secure perimeter to protect against threats and ensure regulatory compliance."
"The application layer leverages Alibaba Cloud Application Load Balancer (ALB) and Auto Scaling for high availability and fault tolerance."

solution_components.name: Application Load Balancer
solution_components.role: Distributes mobile trading traffic and fronts the trading stack for high availability.

solution_components.name: Auto Scaling
solution_components.role: Adds or removes capacity during high-volume trading periods to maintain response times.

solution_components.name: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK)
solution_components.role: Runs the containerized trading application layer that serves mobile users.

solution_components.name: Anti-DDoS
solution_components.role: Protects the platform from volumetric attacks that could disrupt trading access.

solution_components.name: Web Application Firewall (WAF)
solution_components.role: Filters malicious web traffic targeting sensitive trading endpoints.

solution_components.name: Security Center
solution_components.role: Provides centralized threat detection and security governance for the environment.

solution_components.name: Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible)
solution_components.role: Supplies high-speed in-memory data access for latency-sensitive trading workloads.

solution_components.name: Object Storage Service
solution_components.role: Stores persistent trading assets and supporting application data.

solution_components.name: Simple Log Service
solution_components.role: Collects logs for monitoring, troubleshooting, and compliance visibility.

data_flow: Mobile trading requests enter through Application Load Balancer, scale across ACK application nodes via Auto Scaling, read or cache hot data in Tair, persist supporting data in Object Storage Service, and emit operational logs into Simple Log Service under Anti-DDoS, WAF, and Security Center controls.
